task.title: Enforce decision-to-roadmap propagation gaps
task.summary: Detect accepted executable decision rows without durable task/sprint mapping and route them as planning gaps in generated state, resume context, and validation preflight.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki surfaces unplanned accepted executable decision rows as planning blockers instead of leaving them hidden in build history.
acceptance: Decision propagation analysis classifies approved rows as executable task/sprint mapped, knowledge-only/non-executable with durable KB/roadmap disposition, rejected/not-applicable, or unplanned gap.
Generated graph/status and resume context expose unplanned accepted-decision gaps before unrelated implementation or close routing.
Validation preflight consumes the gap signal and blocks planning/implementation/close when accepted executable rows lack task/sprint mapping.

A fixture covers build-only deferred executable rows, including daemon execution graph / worker scheduling follow-up evidence after TASK-070, and reports them as visible planning gaps unless durable roadmap/sprint work exists.
Tests cover task/sprint mapping pass, build-only deferred executable row block, durable knowledge-only/non-executable pass, and resume/status gap display.
non_goals: Do not implement full daemon worker spawning or automatic validator session launch in this task.
Do not require knowledge-only decisions to create roadmap tasks.
Do not replace roadmap tasks, planning builds, validation reports, or Git/content proof.
Do not build a project analytics dashboard.
verification: targeted smoke/fixture tests for decision propagation and gateway blocking

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
